strings.name: S. S. Rajamouli
strings.role: Film director · Telugu epics and action cinema
strings.summary: Rajamouli learned within a filmmaking family and made his feature debut with Student No. 1 in 2001. Combining mythic storytelling, heightened action, music and visual effects, his Baahubali films expanded Telugu cinema across language markets. RRR reached further international audiences. In 2026 he discussed Varanasi, his next film, which had not yet been released.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Expanded Telugu cinema internationally through Baahubali and RRR, advancing Indian genre filmmaking and visual production.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Born in Raichur district, in present-day Karnataka, India.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Studied in Kovvur and Eluru, then learned through editing, television and his father's film work.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Epics across languages
strings.highlights.h1.text: The two Baahubali films expanded Telugu production's audience across Indian languages.
strings.highlights.h2.title: RRR travels internationally
strings.highlights.h2.text: Its combination of action and musical storytelling reached international audiences; Naatu Naatu won an Oscar.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Discussed Varanasi
strings.timeline.t1.text: At a São Paulo festival masterclass, discussed production and mythic influences; release was planned for 2027.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Film song wins an Oscar
strings.timeline.t2.text: RRR's Naatu Naatu won original song, awarded to its composer and lyricist.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Released RRR
strings.timeline.t3.text: Used fictional events around two anticolonial figures to combine action, dance and friendship.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Completed the Baahubali sequel
strings.timeline.t4.text: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion continued the large-scale epic world and widened its audience.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Released the first Baahubali
strings.timeline.t5.text: Built a fictional kingdom through large sets, action and visual effects.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Directed Eega
strings.timeline.t6.text: Integrated visual effects into a fantasy revenge story involving a fly.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Released Magadheera
strings.timeline.t7.text: Combined reincarnation, romance and action in a major Telugu commercial film.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Feature directorial debut
strings.timeline.t8.text: Directed Student No. 1 after television and behind-the-scenes work.
